Name: Fervent Adoration
Description: An enchanting, singular note rings out, to a point you choose within range then blossoms into a song of unmitigated, primal beauty. Each creature of your choice in a 60-foot radius must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, they gain a bonus to their damage equal to their proficiency bonus, and must use the Random Targeting Rule to decide who to attack. You may use your reaction to reroll a singular result once per round.
